method: Final-model recipe of E6b retrained on 100% of the labelled data (no held-out split); scored on Kaggle only
explanation: No validation score by design (all labelled images used for training). Sanity checks: test predictions agree with E6b on most images and the predicted class distribution matches the training distribution. Evaluated only through Kaggle.
preprocessing: Alpha-composite on white background, then resize to 128 x 128 (bicubic), ImageNet normalisation
preprocessing_why: Hyper-parameters were chosen on the 80/20 split; retraining on all 9879 images adds 25% more data, which matters most for the small classes (mozilla 397 images).
